// ─── Firebase Setup ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── const firebaseConfig = { apiKey: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY, authDomain: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN, projectId: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, storageBucket: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET, messagingSenderId: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID, appId: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID, }; const fbApp = initializeApp(firebaseConfig); const fbAuth = getAuth(fbApp); const fbFunctions = getFunctions(fbApp, "australia-southeast1"); const fbDb = getFirestore(fbApp); const fbStorage = getStorage(fbApp); const callGenerateAI = httpsCallable(fbFunctions, "generateAI"); const callGenerateAIJSON = httpsCallable(fbFunctions, "generateAIJSON"); const callExtractDocument = httpsCallable(fbFunctions, "extractDocument"); const callGetMyUsage = httpsCallable(fbFunctions, "getMyUsage"); const callRunSurveyTest = httpsCallable(fbFunctions, "runSurveyTest"); // Session 33: Targeted bulk-send for specific students. See functions/surveys.js. const callRunSurveyForStudents = httpsCallable(fbFunctions, "runSurveyForStudents"); const googleProvider = new GoogleAuthProvider(); // Session 38: Microsoft sign-in support. Uses Firebase's OAuthProvider with // Microsoft as the provider ID. Works for both work/school accounts (Azure AD // / Entra ID) and personal Microsoft accounts (outlook.com, hotmail.com, // live.com), depending on how Microsoft is configured in Firebase Console. // // IMPORTANT — DEPLOYMENT REQUIREMENT: Microsoft must first be enabled as a // sign-in provider in the Firebase Console (Authentication → Sign-in method // → Microsoft → Enable). The Application ID and Application Secret come // from registering the app in Azure Portal: // 1. portal.azure.com → Azure Active Directory → App registrations → New // 2. Set redirect URI to: https://wayfinder-pilot.firebaseapp.com/__/auth/handler // 3. Copy the Application (client) ID into Firebase Console // 4. Generate a client secret in Azure → copy that into Firebase Console too // 5. Test // // Until that configuration is done, this button will fail with a clear // error message that tells the school admin what they need to do. const microsoftProvider = new OAuthProvider("microsoft.com"); // Request additional scopes — email is needed to map the Microsoft user to // our staffEmails / staffMembers entries (which are keyed by email). microsoftProvider.addScope("email"); microsoftProvider.addScope("profile"); // `prompt=select_account` makes Microsoft show the account chooser every // time, which is what people expect when they tap "Sign in with Microsoft" // rather than silently re-using a previous session. microsoftProvider.setCustomParameters({ prompt: "select_account" }); async function signInWithGoogle() { try { const result = await signInWithPopup(fbAuth, googleProvider); return result.user; } catch (error) { console.error("Google sign-in error:", error); throw error; } } async function signInWithMicrosoft() { try { const result = await signInWithPopup(fbAuth, microsoftProvider); return result.user; } catch (error) { console.error("Microsoft sign-in error:", error); // Re-throw with a friendlier message for known failure modes so the // login screen can show actionable text instead of cryptic Firebase codes. if (error?.code === "auth/operation-not-allowed") { const friendlier = new Error("Microsoft sign-in is not yet enabled for this Wayfinder deployment. The school's Wayfinder Administrator needs to enable it in the Firebase Console (Authentication → Sign-in method → Microsoft)."); friendlier.code = error.code; friendlier.original = error; throw friendlier; } throw error; } } async function signOutUser() { await signOut(fbAuth); } // ─── Firestore Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── // Each anonymous user gets their own school document keyed by their uid. // When real auth is added later, this mapping changes — but data structure stays. async function fsCreateSchool(userId, schoolData, ownerInfo) { // ownerInfo = { email, displayName } const schoolRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", userId); const ownerEmail = (ownerInfo?.email || "").toLowerCase(); await setDoc(schoolRef, { ...schoolData, ownerId: userId, staffIds: [userId], staffEmails: ownerEmail ? [ownerEmail] : [], staffMembers: { [userId]: { email: ownerEmail, displayName: ownerInfo?.displayName || ownerEmail, role: "owner", addedAt: new Date().toISOString(), addedBy: userId, status: "active", }, }, invitedEmails: [], pendingInvites: {}, createdAt: serverTimestamp(), updatedAt: serverTimestamp(), }); // Create the owner's membership record await setDoc(doc(fbDb, "userMemberships", userId), { schoolId: userId, role: "owner", joinedAt: serverTimestamp(), }); return userId; } async function fsUpdateSchool(userId, updates) { const schoolRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", userId); await setDoc(schoolRef, { ...updates, updatedAt: serverTimestamp(), }, { merge: true }); } function fsSubscribeSchool(userId, callback) { if (!userId) return () => {}; const schoolRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", userId); return onSnapshot(schoolRef, (snap) => { callback(snap.exists() ? { id: snap.id, ...snap.data() } : null); }, (err) => console.warn("School subscription error:", err)); } // ─── Membership & Invitation Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────── // Data model: // schools/{ownerUid} - keyed by owner's uid (unchanged) // .ownerId = ownerUid // .staffIds: [] - active staff uids (incl. owner) // .staffMembers: { [uid]: { email, displayName, role, addedAt, addedBy, status } } // .invitedEmails: [] - lowercased emails not yet signed in (for query) // .pendingInvites: { [emailLower]: { role, invitedAt, invitedBy } } // // userMemberships/{uid} - which school does this user belong to (1 school per user for now) // .schoolId, .role, .joinedAt // // On sign-in: lookupMembership() decides whether the user is an owner, an invitee // to be accepted, or a brand-new user (will create their own school via M1 setup). async function fsLookupMembership(uid) { if (!uid) return null; const ref = doc(fbDb, "userMemberships", uid); const snap = await getDoc(ref); return snap.exists() ? snap.data() : null; } async function fsFindPendingInviteForEmail(email) { // Returns { schoolId, role } if the email has a pending invite anywhere, else null. if (!email) return null; const lower = email.toLowerCase(); const q = query(collection(fbDb, "schools"), where("invitedEmails", "array-contains", lower)); const snap = await getDocs(q); if (snap.empty) return null; const schoolDoc = snap.docs[0]; const data = schoolDoc.data(); const invite = data.pendingInvites?.[lower]; if (!invite) return null; return { schoolId: schoolDoc.id, role: invite.role, invitedBy: invite.invitedBy }; } async function fsAcceptPendingInvite({ schoolId, uid, email, displayName, role }) { // Move email from pendingInvites/invitedEmails into staffMembers/staffIds, write membership. // ORDER MATTERS: write userMemberships FIRST. The security rule for creating // a membership doc checks isInvited(), which reads invitedEmails. If we update // the school doc first, that array no longer contains the user's email by the // time the rule evaluates the membership write — so the membership write fails // and we end up in a half-accepted state. Reversing the order avoids this. const lower = (email || "").toLowerCase(); const schoolRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId); const snap = await getDoc(schoolRef); if (!snap.exists()) throw new Error("School not found"); const data = snap.data(); const staffMembers = { ...(data.staffMembers || {}) }; const pendingInvites = { ...(data.pendingInvites || {}) }; const staffIds = Array.from(new Set([...(data.staffIds || []), uid])); const staffEmails = Array.from(new Set([...(data.staffEmails || []), lower])); const invitedEmails = (data.invitedEmails || []).filter(e => e !== lower); staffMembers[uid] = { email: lower, displayName: displayName || email, role, addedAt: new Date().toISOString(), addedBy: pendingInvites[lower]?.invitedBy || data.ownerId, status: "active", }; delete pendingInvites[lower]; // Step 1: create the user's membership doc FIRST. At this moment the school // doc still lists the user as invited, so the isInvited() rule passes. await setDoc(doc(fbDb, "userMemberships", uid), { schoolId, role, joinedAt: serverTimestamp(), }); // Step 2: now update the school doc, moving the user from invited -> active. // If this throws, we have a slightly inconsistent state (membership exists // but the school still shows them as invited) — that's recoverable on the // next sign-in because the membership lookup short-circuits before the // invite query runs. await setDoc(schoolRef, { staffIds, staffEmails, staffMembers, invitedEmails, pendingInvites, updatedAt: serverTimestamp(), }, { merge: true }); } async function fsAddStaffInvite(schoolId, email, role, invitedBy) { if (!schoolId || !email || !role) throw new Error("Missing invite fields"); const lower = email.toLowerCase().trim(); const schoolRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId); const snap = await getDoc(schoolRef); if (!snap.exists()) throw new Error("School not found"); const data = snap.data(); // Already an active staff member? if ((data.staffEmails || []).includes(lower)) { throw new Error(`${email} is already a staff member.`); } const invitedEmails = Array.from(new Set([...(data.invitedEmails || []), lower])); const pendingInvites = { ...(data.pendingInvites || {}) }; pendingInvites[lower] = { role, invitedAt: new Date().toISOString(), invitedBy: invitedBy || data.ownerId, }; await setDoc(schoolRef, { invitedEmails, pendingInvites, updatedAt: serverTimestamp(), }, { merge: true }); } async function fsCancelInvite(schoolId, email) { const lower = email.toLowerCase(); const schoolRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId); const snap = await getDoc(schoolRef); if (!snap.exists()) return; const data = snap.data(); const pendingInvites = { ...(data.pendingInvites || {}) }; delete pendingInvites[lower]; const invitedEmails = (data.invitedEmails || []).filter(e => e !== lower); await setDoc(schoolRef, { pendingInvites, invitedEmails, updatedAt: serverTimestamp(), }, { merge: true }); } async function fsRemoveStaff(schoolId, uid) { // Mark removed but keep audit trail entry. const schoolRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId); const snap = await getDoc(schoolRef); if (!snap.exists()) return; const data = snap.data(); if (uid === data.ownerId) throw new Error("Cannot remove the owner."); const staffMembers = { ...(data.staffMembers || {}) }; const removedEmail = staffMembers[uid]?.email; if (staffMembers[uid]) { staffMembers[uid] = { ...staffMembers[uid], status: "removed", removedAt: new Date().toISOString(), }; } const staffIds = (data.staffIds || []).filter(x => x !== uid); const staffEmails = removedEmail ? (data.staffEmails || []).filter(e => e !== removedEmail) : (data.staffEmails || []); await setDoc(schoolRef, { staffIds, staffEmails, staffMembers, updatedAt: serverTimestamp(), }, { merge: true }); // Drop their membership record try { await deleteDoc(doc(fbDb, "userMemberships", uid)); } catch (e) { console.warn("Membership delete failed:", e); } } async function fsUpdateStaffRole(schoolId, uid, newRole) { const schoolRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId); const snap = await getDoc(schoolRef); if (!snap.exists()) return; const data = snap.data(); if (uid === data.ownerId) throw new Error("Cannot change the owner's role."); const staffMembers = { ...(data.staffMembers || {}) }; if (!staffMembers[uid]) throw new Error("Staff member not found."); staffMembers[uid] = { ...staffMembers[uid], role: newRole }; await setDoc(schoolRef, { staffMembers, updatedAt: serverTimestamp() }, { merge: true }); // Update their membership role too await setDoc(doc(fbDb, "userMemberships", uid), { role: newRole }, { merge: true }); } // ─── STAFF DIRECTORY (Session 27) ───────────────────────────────────────────── // The Staff Directory is a roster of every teacher/staff member at the school, // independent of who has a Wayfinder login. It lives alongside `staffMembers` // (the login-user map) at school.staffDirectory. Each entry is keyed by a // generated `dir_` id. // // Why separate from staffMembers? // - staffMembers is keyed by Firebase Auth UID and gates Wayfinder access // - Directory entries don't necessarily have logins — they're just contact // records used for Teaching Team selection, Primary Teacher dropdown, and // (later) survey distribution // - A teacher can exist in both: have a directory entry for student-level // references AND a staffMembers entry for Wayfinder access // // Future Session 28 will wire the directory into student records (replacing // the current free-text teacher fields). async function fsAddStaffDirectoryEntry(schoolId, entry, addedByUid) { if (!schoolId) throw new Error("schoolId required"); if (!entry?.email && !entry?.firstName) throw new Error("First name or email required"); const dirId = `dir_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`; const cleaned = { firstName: (entry.firstName || "").trim(), surname: (entry.surname || "").trim(), displayName: entry.displayName || `${(entry.firstName || "").trim()} ${(entry.surname || "").trim()}`.trim(), email: (entry.email || "").trim().toLowerCase(), role: entry.role || "teacher", responsibility: (entry.responsibility || "").trim(), subjects: Array.isArray(entry.subjects) ? entry.subjects.filter(Boolean) : [], addedAt: new Date().toISOString(), addedBy: addedByUid || null, status: "active", }; const schoolRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId); await setDoc(schoolRef, { staffDirectory: { [dirId]: cleaned }, updatedAt: serverTimestamp(), }, { merge: true }); return { id: dirId, ...cleaned }; } async function fsUpdateStaffDirectoryEntry(schoolId, dirId, updates) { if (!schoolId || !dirId) throw new Error("schoolId and dirId required"); const schoolRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId); const snap = await getDoc(schoolRef); if (!snap.exists()) return; const data = snap.data(); const directory = { ...(data.staffDirectory || {}) }; if (!directory[dirId]) throw new Error("Directory entry not found."); // Recompute displayName if firstName/surname changed and displayName wasn't // explicitly overridden in the updates payload const merged = { ...directory[dirId], ...updates }; if (("firstName" in updates || "surname" in updates) && !("displayName" in updates)) { merged.displayName = `${(merged.firstName || "").trim()} ${(merged.surname || "").trim()}`.trim(); } if ("email" in merged) merged.email = (merged.email || "").toLowerCase(); if (Array.isArray(merged.subjects)) merged.subjects = merged.subjects.filter(Boolean); merged.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString(); directory[dirId] = merged; await setDoc(schoolRef, { staffDirectory: directory, updatedAt: serverTimestamp() }, { merge: true }); return { id: dirId, ...merged }; } async function fsRemoveStaffDirectoryEntry(schoolId, dirId) { if (!schoolId || !dirId) throw new Error("schoolId and dirId required"); const schoolRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId); const snap = await getDoc(schoolRef); if (!snap.exists()) return; const data = snap.data(); const directory = { ...(data.staffDirectory || {}) }; if (!directory[dirId]) return; // Soft delete — preserve audit trail. Future migration can hard-delete if // we add an "Archive" UI. directory[dirId] = { ...directory[dirId], status: "removed", removedAt: new Date().toISOString(), }; await setDoc(schoolRef, { staffDirectory: directory, updatedAt: serverTimestamp() }, { merge: true }); } // Bulk add directory entries (used by the Excel upload component). All entries // are written in a single Firestore set() call to avoid quota churn. async function fsBulkAddStaffDirectoryEntries(schoolId, entries, addedByUid) { if (!schoolId) throw new Error("schoolId required"); if (!Array.isArray(entries) || entries.length === 0) return []; const updates = {}; const created = []; entries.forEach((entry, i) => { const dirId = `dir_${Date.now()}_${i}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`; const cleaned = { firstName: (entry.firstName || "").trim(), surname: (entry.surname || "").trim(), displayName: entry.displayName || `${(entry.firstName || "").trim()} ${(entry.surname || "").trim()}`.trim(), email: (entry.email || "").trim().toLowerCase(), role: entry.role || "teacher", responsibility: (entry.responsibility || "").trim(), subjects: Array.isArray(entry.subjects) ? entry.subjects.filter(Boolean) : [], addedAt: new Date().toISOString(), addedBy: addedByUid || null, status: "active", }; updates[`staffDirectory.${dirId}`] = cleaned; created.push({ id: dirId, ...cleaned }); }); const schoolRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId); await updateDoc(schoolRef, { ...updates, updatedAt: serverTimestamp() }); return created; } async function fsAddStudent(schoolId, studentData) { const studentsRef = collection(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students"); const docRef = await addDoc(studentsRef, { ...studentData, createdAt: serverTimestamp(), updatedAt: serverTimestamp(), }); return docRef.id; } // ─── AUDIT LOG (Session 20) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── // Records every meaningful action against student data so we can answer APP 12 // access requests ("show me everything Wayfinder has on my child") and APP 11 // security obligations ("who has accessed my child's information"). // // Path: schools/{schoolId}/auditLog/{eventId} // // Event shape: // { studentId?, studentName?, eventType, action, actorUid, actorName, // actorEmail, actorRole, details?, timestamp } // // eventType is one of: student | profile | document | goal | meeting | // comms | ilp | studentVoice | aiGeneration | signoff | staff | school // action describes what happened in human-readable form, e.g. // "created", "updated", "uploaded document 'Paediatric Report'", // "generated AI suggestions", "submitted for sign-off" // // We deliberately do NOT record the actual content of edits (that would // duplicate the underlying documents and bloat the log). Instead, the log // records WHAT happened and the underlying record contains the WHEN and // WHAT'S CURRENTLY THERE. async function fsLogAuditEvent(schoolId, event) { if (!schoolId || !event) return; try { const auditRef = collection(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "auditLog"); await addDoc(auditRef, { ...event, timestamp: serverTimestamp(), }); } catch (err) { // Audit failures should not block the underlying action. Log to console // for debugging but don't throw. console.warn("Audit log write failed:", err); } } function fsSubscribeAuditLog(schoolId, callback, options = {}) { if (!schoolId) return () => {}; const auditRef = collection(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "auditLog"); // Default: 500 most recent events. Filtering is done client-side because // Firestore's query language struggles with multi-field optional filters. const q = query(auditRef, orderBy("timestamp", "desc"), limit(options.limit || 500)); return onSnapshot(q, (snap) => { const events = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })); callback(events); }, (err) => { console.warn("Audit log subscription error:", err); callback([]); }); } async function fsUpdateStudent(schoolId, studentId, updates) { const studentRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId); try { await updateDoc(studentRef, { ...updates, updatedAt: serverTimestamp(), }); } catch (writeErr) { // eslint-disable-next-line no-console console.error("[fsUpdateStudent] write failed", { code: writeErr?.code, message: writeErr?.message, }); throw writeErr; } } function fsSubscribeStudents(schoolId, callback) { if (!schoolId) return () => {}; const studentsRef = collection(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students"); return onSnapshot(studentsRef, (snap) => { callback(snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }))); }, (err) => console.warn("Students subscription error:", err)); } async function fsSaveProfile(schoolId, studentId, profileData) { const profileRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "profile", "current"); await setDoc(profileRef, { ...profileData, updatedAt: serverTimestamp(), }); } function fsSubscribeProfile(schoolId, studentId, callback) { if (!schoolId || !studentId) return () => {}; const profileRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "profile", "current"); return onSnapshot(profileRef, (snap) => { callback(snap.exists() ? snap.data() : null); }, (err) => console.warn("Profile subscription error:", err)); } async function fsSaveGoals(schoolId, studentId, goals) { // Goals are stored as a doc per goal under students/{id}/goals/ // For simplicity in this version, we store all goals in one document. const goalsRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "data", "goals"); await setDoc(goalsRef, { items: goals, updatedAt: serverTimestamp(), }); } function fsSubscribeGoals(schoolId, studentId, callback) { if (!schoolId || !studentId) return () => {}; const goalsRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "data", "goals"); return onSnapshot(goalsRef, (snap) => { callback(snap.exists() ? (snap.data().items || []) : []); }, (err) => console.warn("Goals subscription error:", err)); } async function fsSaveEvidence(schoolId, studentId, evidence) { const evRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "data", "evidence"); await setDoc(evRef, { items: evidence, updatedAt: serverTimestamp(), }); } function fsSubscribeEvidence(schoolId, studentId, callback) { if (!schoolId || !studentId) return () => {}; const evRef = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "data", "evidence"); return onSnapshot(evRef, (snap) => { callback(snap.exists() ? (snap.data().items || []) : []); }, (err) => console.warn("Evidence subscription error:", err)); } async function fsAddMeeting(schoolId, studentId, meetingData) { const meetingsRef = collection(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "meetings"); const docRef = await addDoc(meetingsRef, { ...meetingData, createdAt: serverTimestamp(), }); return docRef.id; } function fsSubscribeMeetings(schoolId, studentId, callback) { if (!schoolId || !studentId) return () => {}; const meetingsRef = collection(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "meetings"); return onSnapshot(meetingsRef, (snap) => { const meetings = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })); // Sort by createdAt descending (newest first) meetings.sort((a, b) => { const ta = a.createdAt?.toMillis?.() || 0; const tb = b.createdAt?.toMillis?.() || 0; return tb - ta; }); callback(meetings); }, (err) => console.warn("Meetings subscription error:", err)); } // ─── Comms Log Helpers (M13) ────────────────────────────────────────────────── // Per-student log of school↔family/specialist communications, used as evidence // for NCCD audit. Lives at schools/{schoolId}/students/{studentId}/comms/{id}. async function fsAddComms(schoolId, studentId, commsData) { const ref = collection(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "comms"); const docRef = await addDoc(ref, { ...commsData, createdAt: serverTimestamp(), }); return docRef.id; } async function fsUpdateComms(schoolId, studentId, commsId, updates) { const ref = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "comms", commsId); await setDoc(ref, { ...updates, updatedAt: serverTimestamp() }, { merge: true }); } async function fsDeleteComms(schoolId, studentId, commsId) { const ref = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "comms", commsId); await deleteDoc(ref); } function fsSubscribeComms(schoolId, studentId, callback, teacherUidFilter = null) { // teacherUidFilter: when set (a uid string), constrains the query to docs // where addedBy == that uid. Required for Teachers because firestore.rules // only allows them to read their own comms entries. if (!schoolId || !studentId) return () => {}; const baseRef = collection(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "comms"); const q = teacherUidFilter ? query(baseRef, where("addedBy", "==", teacherUidFilter)) : baseRef; return onSnapshot(q, (snap) => { const items = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() })); items.sort((a, b) => { const ta = a.commsDate ? new Date(a.commsDate).getTime() : (a.createdAt?.toMillis?.() || 0); const tb = b.commsDate ? new Date(b.commsDate).getTime() : (b.createdAt?.toMillis?.() || 0); return tb - ta; }); callback(items); }, (err) => console.warn("Comms subscription error:", err)); } // ─── ILP Sign-off Helpers (M8) ──────────────────────────────────────────────── // Per-student ILP sign-off state. We store it on the student doc itself for // simplicity — there's only ever one current ILP per student. Status flow: // draft → awaiting-signoff → signed (or returned-to-draft with comment). // All audit fields preserved across cycles in `signOffHistory[]`. async function fsSubmitILPForSignoff(schoolId, studentId, submittedBy) { const ref = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId); await setDoc(ref, { signOffStatus: "awaiting-signoff", submittedForSignoffAt: new Date().toISOString(), submittedForSignoffBy: submittedBy, }, { merge: true }); } async function fsSignILP(schoolId, studentId, signerInfo) { // signerInfo: { uid, displayName, signatureName } const ref = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId); const snap = await getDoc(ref); if (!snap.exists()) throw new Error("Student not found"); const data = snap.data(); const history = data.signOffHistory || []; const newEntry = { action: "signed", at: new Date().toISOString(), by: signerInfo.uid, byName: signerInfo.displayName, signatureName: signerInfo.signatureName, }; await setDoc(ref, { signOffStatus: "signed", signedAt: newEntry.at, signedBy: signerInfo.uid, signedByName: signerInfo.displayName, signatureName: signerInfo.signatureName, signOffHistory: [...history, newEntry], }, { merge: true }); } async function fsReturnILP(schoolId, studentId, returnerInfo, comment) { // returnerInfo: { uid, displayName } const ref = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId); const snap = await getDoc(ref); if (!snap.exists()) throw new Error("Student not found"); const data = snap.data(); const history = data.signOffHistory || []; const newEntry = { action: "returned", at: new Date().toISOString(), by: returnerInfo.uid, byName: returnerInfo.displayName, comment: comment || "", }; await setDoc(ref, { signOffStatus: "draft", returnedAt: newEntry.at, returnedBy: returnerInfo.uid, returnComment: comment || "", signOffHistory: [...history, newEntry], }, { merge: true }); } // ─── Teacher Progress Survey Config Helpers (M9 / Session 5) ────────────────── // Per-student survey configuration: questions, cadence, rotation rules, status. // Lives at schools/{schoolId}/students/{studentId}/surveys/config (single doc). // Session 5 (this build): config CRUD only — no cycles, no emails, no responses. // Session 6 will add the cycle/email machinery on top of this config. async function fsLoadSurveyConfig(schoolId, studentId) { const ref = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "surveys", "config"); const snap = await getDoc(ref); if (!snap.exists()) return null; return snap.data(); } function fsSubscribeSurveyConfig(schoolId, studentId, callback) { if (!schoolId || !studentId) return () => {}; const ref = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "surveys", "config"); return onSnapshot(ref, (snap) => { callback(snap.exists() ? snap.data() : null); }, (err) => console.warn("Survey config subscription error:", err)); } async function fsSaveSurveyConfig(schoolId, studentId, config, lastEditedBy) { const ref = doc(fbDb, "schools", schoolId, "students", studentId, "surveys", "config"); Phone photos are typically 3-5 // MB at 4032×3024 (12MP). Display sizes in Wayfinder max out around 120 px // (cover circle) or 36 px (sidebar avatar). Compressing to 800 px max edge // at JPEG q=0.85 reduces a 4 MB file to ~150-300 KB with no visible quality // loss at display size, cuts mobile upload time, and reduces storage cost. // // Returns a File object — same interface as the original — so callers don't // need to change. If compression fails for any reason (corrupt image, // unsupported format, browser quirk), falls back to the original file // rather than blocking the upload. async function compressImage(file, { maxEdge = 800, quality = 0.85, minBytesToCompress = 200 * 1024 } = {}) { // Skip compression for files already smaller than threshold — not worth // the canvas overhead on a 100 KB file. if (!file || !file.type || !file.type.startsWith("image/") || file.size < minBytesToCompress) { return file; } // Don't try to compress GIFs (would lose animation) or SVGs (vector — no // benefit). WebP and HEIC also compress. if (file.type === "image/gif" || file.type === "image/svg+xml") { return file; } try { const dataUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const reader = new FileReader(); reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result); reader.onerror = () => reject(reader.error || new Error("FileReader failed")); reader.readAsDataURL(file); }); const img = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const i = new Image(); i.onload = () => resolve(i); i.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Image decode failed")); i.src = dataUrl; }); let { width, height } = img; // If already small enough, no resize needed — but we still pass through // canvas to apply JPEG quality compression. if (width > maxEdge || height > maxEdge) { if (width >= height) { height = Math.round(height * (maxEdge / width)); width = maxEdge; } else { width = Math.round(width * (maxEdge / height)); height = maxEdge; } } const canvas = document.createElement("canvas"); canvas.width = width; canvas.height = height; const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d"); // Better resampling quality for downsizing ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true; ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = "high"; ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height); const blob = await new Promise((resolve) => { canvas.toBlob(resolve, "image/jpeg", quality); }); if (!blob) return file; // toBlob can return null on some browsers — fall back // Replace extension with .jpg since we always output JPEG. Rules: - 4-8 words maximum per item. - Strip any student name. The teacher already knows whose row it is. - Keep the actionable noun phrase. Examples: - Input: "Extended time + oral response accepted as alternative format" → "Extra time, oral option" - Input: "Visual schedule and first-then board displayed in classroom" → "Visual schedule" - Input: "Quiet reading corner available on request during independent work" → "Quiet reading space" - Input: "Modified texts at Year 5 level" → "Modified texts (Year 5)" - Input: "Buddy system at lunch breaks" → "Buddy system at break" Input items: ${numbered} Return: JSON array of ${capped.length} short strings.`; try { const result = await aiJ(prompt, 2000); // Result might be the array directly, or wrapped { items: [...] }, or null let arr = result; if (!Array.isArray(arr) && result && Array.isArray(result.items)) arr = result.items; if (!Array.isArray(arr) || arr.length !== capped.length) { console.warn("[summariseAdjustments] unexpected AI output shape:", result); return {}; } const map = {}; capped.forEach((original, i) => { const short = (arr[i] || "").trim(); if (short && short !== original) map[original] = short; }); return map; } catch (err) { console.warn("[summariseAdjustments] AI call failed, falling back to originals:", err); return {}; } } const uid = () => Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9); // Session 44 / 45: Wayfinder logo as a reusable React component.
